capture_rule: Capture each registered NIST TRC ThermoML JSON and landing record byte-for-byte. From the boiling source retain every directly reported experimental boiling-temperature-at-pressure dataset and every point in source order. From the freezing source retain every directly reported experimental solid-liquid-equilibrium-temperature dataset and every point in source order. From the osmotic source retain every directly reported experimental osmotic-coefficient dataset and every point in source order. Preserve every companion compound, phase, method, uncertainty and non-target dataset in all three complete parent sources. Do not select a solvent, solute, concentration, temperature, pressure, favorable response, interval or row. Do not use correlated, smoothed, derived-from-model, predicted or model-calculated values as measurements or derivation inputs.

allowed_before_target_release: admitted foundational, exact-arithmetic, finite-support, composition, equilibrium and phase laws
registered source identity, DOI, response class, dataset and row ordinals
direct experimental presentation and method class only
forbidden_before_target_release: temperature, pressure, composition, response or uncertainty inscription
phase outcome or target payload hash
van't Hoff factor or dissociation parameter
Raoult law, boiling/freezing constant or osmotic equation
molality/molarity response equation, continuum, logarithm, interpolation, regression or fitted coefficient
selected solvent, solute, concentration, temperature, pressure, dataset, row, interval or target-derived correction
